messages:
lina: FYI team: Deploybot will run sequenced pins during the 03:00-05:00 UTC change window. Planned order: runtime@2.4.0 -> api@1.13.0 -> console@4.0.1 -> router@3.8.3. This is a small change but cross-service so putting a short watch.

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight completed at 02:45 UTC. No unresolved migrations. Will apply pins with 8s gap and emit step events here.

raj: I'll start the runtime warmup at 02:58. Canary: 7% traffic to group-b for 8 minutes then ramp if stable. Warming KV prefixes /prefix/session/* and /prefix/ctx/*.

emma_oncall: Rollback thresholds we agreed: 0.4% error rate sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 400ms baseline. If triggered, we do staged unpin: console/router first to shrink surface, then api, then runtime. I have unpin perms.

lina: Note: console has a non-blocking feature flag toggle which can be turned off quickly if UI regressions appear.

ops_jen: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/deploy-sequence. Alerts to mute: latency-spike-alert and deploy-noise.

raj: Starting canary now (02:58). Logs: warmup endpoints returning 200 across 4 shards.

deploybot: runtime pinned -> api pending -> console queued -> router queued. Event IDs: evt_abc123.

lina: Watching metrics dashboard. Posting snapshots every 2m.

emma_oncall: If rollback: quick unpin commands below. I'll annotate ticket when I run them.

```
# unpin console
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"console","version":"4.0.1"}'
# unpin router
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.8.3"}'
```

raj: Canary at +6m: error rate steady at 0.05%, p95 latency +12ms. No obvious regressions. Continuing.

lina: Adding a short note to release notes about the ordering and rollback steps. Also flagging that db migration is zero-downtime.

deploybot: api pinned -> console pending -> router pending.

emma_oncall: If anything noisy happens, call the sequence: 1) mute alerts 2) open incident 3) unpin staged 4) rollback traffic. I'll be on pager for the next 30m.

lina: Thanks — will post final completion when router is pinned and smoke tests pass. :white_check_mark:
